market_summary: Nothing new came in today and nothing left: 139 listings still match, with no new entries, no removals and no price changes. The median asking price holds at 2 995 000 kr, about 227 700 kr per ha. Småland (44) and Dalsland/Värmland (33) still carry the supply, and Göteborg hinterland has the highest median at 3 350 000 kr. The standing list is already correct, and a quiet market like this keeps the negotiating room on listings that have been out for months.
